open_fire.name: Open Fire!
open_fire.text: A unit fires immediately with +3 damage.

upgrade.text: A unit fires immediately with +5 damage.

medic.name: Medic
medic.text: Deploy. 4 HP. End of turn: heal adjacent units 2.

upgrade.text: Deploy. 5 HP. End of turn: heal adjacent units 3.

mortar_team.name: Mortar Team
mortar_team.text: Deploy to back row. 4 HP, fires 4 Indirect at the toughest enemy.

upgrade.text: Deploy to back row. 5 HP, fires 6 Indirect at the toughest enemy.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.text: Deploy to back row. 3 HP, fires 6 Precision at the weakest enemy.

upgrade.text: Deploy to back row. 4 HP, fires 8 Precision at the weakest enemy.

bazooka.name: Bazooka
bazooka.text: Deploy. 4 HP, fires 6 Direct. Ignores Armor and deals +50% to armored targets.

upgrade.text: Deploy. 5 HP, fires 8 Direct. Ignores Armor and deals +50% to armored targets.

sherman.name: Sherman
sherman.text: Deploy to front row. 18 HP, Armor 2, fires 6 Direct.

upgrade.text: Deploy to front row. 22 HP, Armor 3, fires 7 Direct.

grenade.name: Grenade
grenade.text: Deal 6 Indirect damage to any enemy.

upgrade.text: Deal 9 Indirect damage to any enemy.

smoke_screen.name: Smoke Screen
smoke_screen.text: Smoke your front row: enemy Direct fire against it misses this round.

advance.name: Advance
advance.text: Move a back-row unit to the front row. It fires.

upgrade.text: Move a back-row unit to the front row. It fires with +2 damage.

fall_back.name: Fall Back
fall_back.text: Move a front-row unit to the back row. Heal it 3.

upgrade.text: Move a front-row unit to the back row. Heal it 6.

suppressing_fire.name: Suppressing Fire
suppressing_fire.text: Apply 2 Suppressed to every enemy in the front row.

upgrade.text: Apply 3 Suppressed to every enemy in the front row.

hold_the_line.name: Hold the Line
hold_the_line.text: Doctrine. Start of turn: your front-row units gain 2 Cover.
